title: Quick Seared Portuguese Beef Skillet
description: A citrusy and aerated weeknight Portuguese dish featuring beef, flambe, and low calorie friendly ingredients, perfect for a quick dinner
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat
Add the beef strips and cook for 3 minutes per side, or until browned
Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside
Add the garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, or until fragrant
Add the paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and cook for 1 minute
Add the white wine to the skillet and bring to a boil, scraping up any browned bits
Add the lemon juice to the skillet and stir to combine
Return the beef to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes, or until cooked to desired level of doneness
Stir in the chopped parsley and serve hot
